original_hook: 🎯 When $TFUEL volume exploded from under $900k to 133.8M tokens in a single 1-hour candle to hit $0.01378, it looked like a massive breakout. Then volume instantly collapsed back to 3.6M while price gave back over 60% of the move to $0.01118—all with zero official news. This is the classic signature of an illiquid order-book sweep. A concentrated buy order clears thin sell depth, triggering momentum algos and stop orders in a chain reaction. But without organic follow-through, market makers re-hedge, liquidity evaporates, and price drifts back down. Unless unannounced news hits later to signal insider accumulation, losing $0.0110 confirms complete liquidity exhaustion. Reclaiming $0.0122 Which level confirms your setup on $TFUEL?
